title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Underwriting Guideline: One Coverage per Vehicle
content:
**Guideline.** Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage is held per vehicle. A vehicle carries at most one physical damage coverage at a time, and a customer may hold as many physical damage coverages as there are vehicles scheduled on their auto policies; the coverage has no cap of its own on the number a customer holds. A coverage can be added to a vehicle only when no coverage on that vehicle is pending inspection, active or in storage. Each vehicle's deductible option is chosen independently, and options are never pooled across vehicles.

## Basis of the vehicle check

- The check rests on the system record of the vehicle's physical damage coverages and their status, matched on the vehicle itself — not on the customer's statement of what the vehicle carries.
- The statuses that block a new coverage on the same vehicle are **pending inspection**, **active** and **storage**. A coverage in **removed** status is not one of them.

| Status of an existing coverage on the same vehicle | Blocks adding a coverage to that vehicle under this guideline |
|---|---|
| Pending inspection | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Storage | Yes |
| Removed | No |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical households)

- A customer with three scheduled vehicles may carry Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage on all three; the count is limited only by the vehicles scheduled, never by a per-customer maximum.
- Two vehicles of one household may sit on different deductible options, for example one on the Cardinal Physical Damage $500 Deductible and one on the Cardinal Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible; each vehicle's option stands on its own.
- A vehicle whose earlier coverage shows removed, and no other coverage, does not meet the blocking condition of this guideline.
